qr_desc: Scan the code to enter data via your phone.
speech_unavailable: Speech recognition is not available on this device.
speech_language_missing: Speech recognition for the selected language is not available on this device.
continue_unavailable: This item is not available in the currently loaded playlist.
download_failed: Download failed. Check your connection and available storage.
download_season_failed: Some episodes could not be downloaded. Check your connection and available storage.
stream_load_failed: The stream could not be started. Check the playlist, internet connection and stream URL.
playlist_management_subtitle: Name playlists, assign folders, and show or hide them
playlist_visibility_hint: Choose which playlists appear in normal source and folder navigation. Hidden playlists remain saved and can still be activated manually here. Hiding never deletes data.
playlist_empty: No playlist profiles saved yet. Add a playlist to manage it here.
playlist_security_note: Playlist names, folders and visibility are stored in SharedPreferences. Remote M3U URLs and Xtream credentials are protected separately in Android Secure Storage. Imported local M3U files are stored in the app-private area and can be reloaded.
